reason: v2 stationary raw state signature was inconsistent at 384 landmarks; diagnostic convergence study at 768/1024 landmarks passed on both old splits, while random-motion raw states still failed. These old diagnostics cannot serve as confirmation.
neuron_selection: exactly the immutable v2 discovery-only 483-cell mask; no additional selection, no threshold relaxation
statistic: unchanged v1/v2 raw Euclidean joint H0/H1/H2 statistic and thresholds, median-distance cutoff; no PCA/UMAP in primary test
null_optimization: Compute full H1 first. If necessary H1 lifetime or separation conditions fail, the prescribed joint statistic is exactly zero regardless of H2; record H2 as not computed rather than fabricated. Otherwise compute full H2. This is algebraically equivalent to the original conjunction statistic.
multiple_testing: Holm across ten source/method/condition slots per split: v1 two source candidates; v2 four source-condition candidates; v3 four source-condition candidates. Unavailable candidates have p=1. Account for all method attempts, not just the final selected analysis.
acceptance: both NEW heldout splits, same condition, pass raw field47 signature, field2 and 1024-landmark sensitivity, Holm p<=0.05. Stationary success cannot establish random-motion or all-neuron torus.
no_further_refinements: If this fixed-cell convergence confirmation fails, report no robust raw-state torus acceptance; do not keep changing selections or thresholds.
raw_recording: all 4096 units at step20, initial place code and full 20-step input/position history; after acceptance collect all 0..20 raw states in a separate matched-sample experiment
